cli.intro_scopes: The scopes come from the GitHub CLI and cannot be changed from Gitify. Its <0>repo</0> scope covers notification access; run <1>gh auth refresh -s notifications</1> to grant that scope explicitly.
cli.intro_token: Uses the token your local <0>gh</0> install already holds, so no token has to be created or pasted. Gitify reads it from the CLI on every refresh, which means <1>gh auth login</1> and <2>gh auth refresh</2> keep working without re-authenticating here.

reasons.approval_requested_description: You were requested to review and approve a deployment.
reasons.assign_description: You were assigned to the issue.
reasons.author: Authored
reasons.ci_activity_description: A GitHub Actions workflow run was triggered for your repository.
reasons.invitation_description: You accepted an invitation to contribute to the repository.
reasons.manual_description: You subscribed to the thread (via an issue or pull request).
reasons.member_feature_requested_description: Organization members have requested to enable a feature such as Draft Pull Requests or Copilot.
reasons.mention_description: You were specifically @mentioned in the content.
reasons.review_requested_description: You, or a team you're a member of, were requested to review a pull request.
reasons.security_advisory_credit_description: You were credited for contributing to a security advisory.
reasons.security_alert_description: GitHub discovered a security vulnerability in your repository.

appearance.increase_contrast_help: Use GitHub's high-contrast color schemes for improved legibility. Also applied automatically when your system's increase-contrast setting is enabled.
appearance.show_account_header_help: When enabled, displays an account header (avatar, username and quick links) above the notifications list.
appearance.show_status_icon_colors_help: Color the notification type icons by their state (open, closed, done, attention). Glass renders them monochrome by default.
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.wrap_notification_title_help: Wrap long notification titles onto multiple lines instead of truncating with an ellipsis. This shows the full title but may increase the height of the notification list.

notifications.delay_state_help: Keep the notification within {{appName}} upon interaction (ie: open notification, mark as read, mark as done) until the next refresh window (scheduled or user initiated).
notifications.fetch_all_help: When <0>checked</0>, {{appName}} will fetch <1>all</1> notifications from your inbox. When <2>unchecked</2>, {{appName}} will fetch the first page of notifications (max 50 records per GitHub account)
notifications.fetch_detailed_caution: ⚠️ Users with a large number of unread notifications may experience rate limiting under certain circumstances. Please disable this setting if you experience this.
notifications.fetch_detailed_help: When <0>checked</0>, {{appName}} will enrich notifications with detailed user and state information. You may also choose to display <1>notification metric pills</1> or <2>notification reference numbers</2>. When <3>unchecked</3>, {{appName}} will only fetch basic notification details.
notifications.fetch_read_done_caution: ⚠️ GitHub's API does not distinguish between read and done states, so 'Mark as done' actions will be unavailable when this setting is enabled.
notifications.fetch_read_help: Fetch all notifications including read and done.
notifications.fetch_read_rate_caution: ⚠️ Enabling this setting will increase API usage and may cause rate limiting for users with many notifications.
notifications.group_by_help: Choose how notifications are displayed in the list. <0>Repository</0> groups notifications by their repository full name. <1>Date</1> shows notifications in chronological order.
notifications.mark_done_help: <0>Mark as done</0> feature is supported in GitHub Cloud and GitHub Enterprise Server 3.13 or later.
notifications.participating_docs_title: Open GitHub documentation for participating and watching notifications
notifications.participating_help: When <0>checked</0>, {{appName}} will fetch only participating notifications. When <1>unchecked</1>, {{appName}} will fetch participating and watching notifications. See <2>official docs</2> for more details.
notifications.scope_warning: One or more accounts are missing scopes required for notification enrichment. Notification details may be incomplete. Visit <0>Accounts → Scopes</0> to review.
notifications.title: Notifications

reset.confirm_content: Please confirm that you want to reset all settings to the Gitify defaults
reset.title: Reset Settings

system.gnome_extension_help: On GNOME Wayland, install the Gitify extension to open the window next to its tray icon. Install and manage it through GNOME's extension tools.
system.keep_window_on_blur: Keep window open when it loses focus
system.keep_window_on_blur_help: Prevent the {{appName}} window from automatically hiding when you click outside it.
system.keyboard_shortcut_help: Global keyboard shortcut to show or hide {{appName}}.
system.open_links_background_help: <0>Background</0> opens the link without stealing focus from the current window.
system.open_links_foreground_help: <0>Foreground</0> will open the link and bring the opened window or browser to the front.
system.open_links_help: Controls the behavior of how external links should opened.
system.show_notifications_help: Display native operating system notifications for new unread notifications.
system.show_update_notifications_help: Show a notification when a {{appName}} update is ready. Updates will still be checked and shown in the menu bar.
system.title: System
system.use_x11_backend_help: Run under X11/XWayland so the window opens next to the tray icon. On Wayland, window placement depends on your compositor and its extensions. Enabling this also disables Vulkan, which crashes under X11 on some drivers, and may soften text on displays using fractional scaling. Takes effect after restarting {{appName}}.

tray.highlight_unread_help: Use a green {{appName}} logo when there are unread notifications.
tray.idle_icon_help: Choose a light icon for a dark panel, or a dark icon for a light panel.
tray.idle_icon_help_automatic: Automatic follows the system tray appearance on macOS and Windows. On Linux, it uses a light icon because panel appearance cannot be detected reliably.
tray.idle_icon_help_theme: This setting is independent of Gitify's app theme.
tray.show_notification_count_help: Show the unread notification count next to the tray icon. Useful for a quick glance at unread activity.
tray.title: Tray
